criteria.extension: A university extension or teaching page about growing or identifying the species
criteria.flora: A flora or a monograph of the species or its genus: a botanical description of the plant as it grows wild
criteria.forestry: A forestry or silvics manual, a yield table, or a forest or woodland body's account of the tree as it grows in its native woods
criteria.garden: A botanical garden's or an arboretum's page about the species
criteria.nursery: A nursery's, a landscape designer's or a retailer's page about the plant it sells or plants
criteria.other: Any other document: an encyclopedia, a news or forum post, a blog, a database record, a paper on another subject
criteria.unclear: The address, title and passages do not say what the document is

document.instructions: The state holds one document found about the tree species `species`: its address and title in `source`, and up to three sentences from it in `passages`. What kind of document is it?
